repeated_statement_policy: For coded Zambia syllabus items, merge candidates with the same stable statement_code and same source statement type. Merge repeated candidates caused by row-span or fill-down table layout when they refer to the same code. Do not merge distinct specific competences that have different four-part codes, even when their text is similar across grades or components.
duplicate_review_instructions: Review possible duplicate Zambia Literacy and Language candidates conservatively. Stable official codes are primary: the same code and statement type should normally merge with combined provenance; different specific competence codes should remain distinct. Treat repeated rows created by table continuation, row spans, or fill-down as layout duplicates when the code and statement text are the same. Do not merge similar skills across Grade 1, Grade 2, and Grade 3 unless they are clearly the same source item repeated by extraction.
learning_component_instructions: Create LearningComponents primarily from leaf Specific Competence SFIs. Use the source English text as-is. Prefer a 1-to-1 component when the competence is already atomic. Split only when one specific competence clearly contains multiple distinct language skills. Do not create LearningComponents from Topic or Sub-topic grouping nodes, Learning Activities, Expected Standard benchmarks, methodology prose, or the Key Competences table unless a later profile explicitly marks them as LC sources.
sfi_extraction_instructions: Extract Zambia Literacy and Language StandardsFrameworkItem candidates from the English Language lower-primary syllabus tables. Use the grade heading as grade context: Grade 1, Grade 2, or Grade 3. Treat Listening and Speaking, Reading, and Writing as component/strand grouping SFIs. In syllabus tables with columns Topic, Sub-topic, Specific Competences, Learning Activities, and Expected Standard, extract Topic and Sub-topic as Standard Grouping SFIs using their stable codes. Extract Specific Competences as the main leaf Standard SFIs and preserve the four-part statement_code. Treat Expected Standard as a descriptor or benchmark attached to the corresponding Specific Competence, not as a standalone Standard unless it is the only clear normative expectation in the row. Treat Learning Activities as guidance only, not SFIs for v0. Ignore front-matter tables such as Key Competences to be Developed for SFI extraction. Use rows_filldown for interpreting row-span context, but preserve raw row/cell text and provenance. Always retain page indices, table segment id, row order, source column, statement code, grade, component, topic, and sub-topic context.
